label: About
title: About The Far Side Rises
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 852 captured links. The preserved plate takes its primary source material from Gaming Aesthetics (@zgameaesthetic), showing Final Fantasy VIII (1999). Six source windows remain: that game environment, four recordings, and Simone Conradi’s mathematical artwork. During editorial review, the Paisajitos window was explicitly removed because its owning source announced a release on the objkt marketplace. Its foreground-violet-ellipse interaction and source poster were removed, not relabeled or replaced. The generated plate itself is unchanged; the ellipse remains part of the artwork but is no longer interactive.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
